summary: Frontend-only validation of Trost first-partner ordering, new Trost launch section/announcement bar, and removal of Cosmos physical location. All 9 acceptance criteria PASS. No console/JS errors on home, shop, passport.
verified_checks: Announcement bar visible on home, shop, passport with correct text 'Trost opens its own store tomorrow — Saturday, 12 September 2026 · Richmond Town, Bangalore →' and href /#trost-launch; clicking navigates to homepage Trost section.
Partner Brands grid order: Trost (with red '[ First Partner ]' tag) → Moon Impact → Cannazo. data-testid partner-brand-trost is the first item.

Homepage featured products grid (data-testid='home-featured-grid') first card is TROST 'Mello Gummies — Blueberry' followed by Moon Impact then Cannazo (3 cards — one per partner brand, since only 3 partner brands exist; grid slice(0,4) yields 3 which is expected).
Shop filter pills order: All, Trost, Moon Impact, Cannazo. Clicking Trost filters to 3 Trost products only.

Trost launch section (data-testid='trost-launch-section') renders with 'Saturday, 12 September 2026' and 'Richmond Town, Bangalore' cards. 'Visit the Store' href = https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Richmond+Town,+Bangalore. 'Explore Trost' href = /brand/trost.
Navbar: 'Store' link present with href '/#trost-launch'; 'Location' link removed (0 occurrences).

Footer: no 'Indiranagar' anywhere; Contact column present with info@cosmoscannabis.in, +91 90369 47840, 'Partner store: Trost — Richmond Town, Bangalore'; 'Trost Store' link in Explore column present with href /#trost-launch.
Regression: no 'Indiranagar' / 'storefront' references on homepage. Dark theme intact.
Age gate confirmed via 21+ button; countdown popup closes via X. No JS runtime errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js: featured grid slices to 4 but with only 3 partner brands only 3 cards render — fine for now; if a 4th brand is added the slice remains correct.
Navbar links use plain <a href> for /#trost-launch which causes full-page navigation on non-home routes; this works but a Link with useEffect scroll would be cleaner (non-blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Trost first-partner + announcement bar + physical-store-removal changes verified on Sep 11, 2026. Only 3 partner brands exist, so featured grid shows 3 cards (expected). Age gate uses button with text containing '21'. Countdown popup closes via aria-label='Close' or lucide-x button.
